chk_expliziter_verweis_one_parent.name: chk_expliziter_verweis_one_parent
chk_expliziter_verweis_one_parent.value:
(
CASE
    WHEN (rechtsfolge_id IS NOT NULL) THEN 1
    ELSE 0
END +
CASE
    WHEN (atomares_tbm_id IS NOT NULL) THEN 1
    ELSE 0
END) = 1

chk_fundstelle_scores_in_range.name: chk_fundstelle_scores_in_range
chk_fundstelle_scores_in_range.value:
(confidence IS NULL OR confidence BETWEEN 0 AND 1)
AND (consensus_ratio IS NULL OR consensus_ratio BETWEEN 0 AND 1)
AND (relevance IS NULL OR relevance BETWEEN 0 AND 1)
